# INCUBEX 2026

> INCUBEX 2026 is Ignisia's national-level student tech launchpad at MIT-WPU Pune on 21 October 2026.

## Official resources

- [Official INCUBEX 2026 website](https://incubex.ignisia.tech/)
- [Registration on Unstop](https://unstop.com/p/incubex-by-ignisia-2026-national-level-tech-launchpad-mit-world-peace-university-pune-maharashtra-1759743)
- [Official INCUBEX 2026 brochure](https://incubex.ignisia.tech/assets/incubex-poster.pdf)
- [Ignisia organizer website](https://ignisia.tech/)

## Verified event facts

- Date and time: 21 October 2026, 9:00 AM-6:00 PM IST
- Venue: Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Format: Online screening followed by an on-campus Grand Finale
- Tracks: Product Track and Prototype Expo
- Audience: Undergraduate and postgraduate student teams across India
- Registration fee: INR 300 per team; free for MIT-WPU Pune students
- Registration closes: 5 October 2026
- Online qualifier rounds: 8–9 October 2026
- Qualifier results: 12 October 2026
- Online mentoring sessions: 15–16 October 2026
- Prize pool: INR 50,000, plus consolation prize vouchers and credits
- Finalist participation fee: INR 600 per shortlisted team
- Finalists: 80 teams, comprising 30 Product Track teams and 50 Prototype Expo teams

For current deadlines, rules, eligibility, and registration status, use the official website, brochure, and Unstop registration page above.
